# Barchart

> > Financial market data platform providing real-time quotes, technical analysis, and trading tools for stocks, options, futures, ETFs, forex, and cryptocurrencies.

Barchart delivers comprehensive market intelligence across global asset classes including major indices (S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Dow, Russell 2000), commodities, currencies (Bitcoin, Ether), and volatility indicators (VIX, VSTOXX). The platform specializes in technical screening, signal generation, and options strategies for active traders and investors.

## Key Topics

- VIX (Volatility Index)
- Bitcoin and Ether cryptocurrency
- S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Dow Futures, Russell 2000
- SOFR, EuriBor, ESTR, SONIA, SARON (interest rate benchmarks)
- Euro Stoxx 50, VSTOXX (European markets)
- Options trading and screeners
- Futures contract specifications
- ETF technical signals
- Stock screening and analysis
- Highs/lows price extremes
- Market data and quotes
- Commodities futures
- Currency pairs and forex
- Trading signals and ratings

## Stock Market Analysis

- [Stock Market Quotes, Stock Charts, Market News](https://www.barchart.com/stocks): Main stock market hub with quotes, charts, analysis and news
- [Top Stocks to Own](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/signals/top-bottom/top): Top-rated stocks by highest Signals Rating and technical strength
- [Bottom Stocks to Own](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/signals/top-bottom/bottom): Bottom-rated stocks by weakest Signals Rating and technical trends
- [Summary of Stocks With New Highs & Lows](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/highs-lows/summary): Overview of stocks making new highs and lows across timeframes
- [All US Exchanges 52-Week New Lows](https://www.barchart.com/stocks/highs-lows/lows): Stocks hitting new 52-week lows across all US exchanges
- [Today's Up Trending Stocks](https://www.barchart.com/investing-ideas/up-trending): Stocks with bullish trends across 5, 20 and 50-day moving averages

## Options Trading Tools

- [Today's Stock Option Quotes and Volatility](https://www.barchart.com/options): Stock options quotes, chains, volatility data and unusual activity
- [Earnings in the next Trading Day](https://www.barchart.com/options/upcoming-earnings): Upcoming earnings calendar with options straddle opportunities
- [Long Straddle Option Screener](https://www.barchart.com/options/straddles-strangles/long-straddle): Long straddle options screener for volatility trading strategies
- [Married Put Option Screener](https://www.barchart.com/options/protection-strategies/married-put): Married put screener for portfolio protection and risk management

## Futures Markets

- [all Futures 1-Month Highs & Lows](https://www.barchart.com/futures/highs-lows): All futures contracts 1-month price extremes with dates and changes
- [Indices Futures Contract Specifications](https://www.barchart.com/futures/contract-specifications/indices): Index futures specs: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, Russell 2000 E-Mini
- [Today's European Futures Performance Leaders](https://www.barchart.com/futures/european/performance-leaders): Top European futures contracts ranked by daily percent change
- [European all Futures 1-Month Highs & Lows](https://www.barchart.com/futures/european/highs-lows): European futures 1-month price extremes with dates and changes
- [Currencies Futures First Notice Dates](https://www.barchart.com/futures/first-notice-dates/currencies): Currency futures first notice dates and contract expiration calendar
- [Grains Futures Options Expirations Calendar](https://www.barchart.com/futures/options-expirations/grains): Grains futures options expiration dates for wheat, corn, soybeans

## ETF Signals & Screening

- [ETFs Signal Downgrades](https://www.barchart.com/etfs-funds/signals/downgrades): ETFs ranked by highest negative Opinion Change for trading signals
- [New 100 Percent Sells ETF Signal Recommendations](https://www.barchart.com/etfs-funds/signals/100-percent-sells): ETFs with 100% sell signals across all 13 technical indicators

## Forex & Cryptocurrencies

- [Forex 1-Month Highs/Lows for Popular Currency Pairs](https://www.barchart.com/forex/highs-lows): Forex currency pairs 1-month high/low price ranges and percent changes
- [Monero Prices](https://www.barchart.com/crypto/coins/XMR): Monero (XMR) cryptocurrency prices, charts and technical analysis
